author: ShrikeArghast
quote:
Complete garbage:

1) Lucia is an objectively awful person who you are chained to for the entire game. You can't cheat on her; you can't leave her; you can't fly solo.
2) 30 FPS cap. Completely bogus, verging on trash considering the amount of money the PS5 costs.
3) Limitations on what crimes you can commit, who you can shoot, and when. What happened to the sandbox?
4) Totally mundane chore-simulator first hour+. 
5) Nothing racy ever happens. You can't sleep with hookers; you can't date any of the (way hotter than Lucia) women you see. Your character is a simp, and he behaves like a simp.

Seriously: given the hype, the development bucks involved, the GTA legacy, and the absolutely berserk (but completely predictable) media reaction, this woke mess is a terrible game.
